runtime: V8 isolate; minimal node:test/assert module loader; scripted transports, no Node or browser

results.name: token format is checked locally; nothing is sent for a malformed token
connect reads health, lists, then a selection asks one snapshot; the token is only in the header argument
pagination sends next_cursor unchanged and stops at the end; never more than three pages
list RESET_REQUIRED keeps the old inventory marked stale; an explicit relist starts without cursor
401 forgets the token, stops, keeps the last data marked stale and drops answers still in flight
403 (Host/Origin) and 503 stop requests and keep the last state; 400 is a Core error, not a capture
network failure: offline, data kept and dated; reconnect to the same store resumes
reconnection to another store wipes the previous display: no mixed identities
a list answering for another store than health is refused and nothing is shown
an answer for a previous selection never replaces the current one
disconnect forgets token and display; a late answer is dropped
poll: DELTA drains has_more within five pages; RESET_REQUIRED waits for the explicit reload
an invalid or authority-claiming answer is rejected, never displayed
a malformed mission id is never turned into a request path
G036 FOUND: historical APPROVED then REVOKED are records next to a current REVOKED capture, never merged
G036 cancellation receipt: REQUESTED is recorded, not a confirmed stop
G036 NOT_FOUND keeps the uncertainty; nothing else is asked or sent
G036 STORE_CHANGED blocks further lookups until an explicit reconnection; mismatch and unavailable stay local
G036 invalid keys are never sent; answers that do not echo the question or claim authority are refused
G036 a receipt answer arriving after another selection, or after disconnect, is dropped
G048 receipt_binding: EVENT_HASH and LEGACY_FIELDS kept, absent stays unspecified, unknown or misplaced refused
G043 a 200 list page refused by the protocol does not advance lastSuccessAt and is reported
G043 a 200 snapshot refused (other store) or older than the shown one does not advance freshness
G043 an answer for a previous list epoch does not advance freshness
G043 two concurrent connections: only the last one is applied, the first answer never counts
G043 RESET_REQUIRED is an accepted protocol answer, but the frozen view is never presented as current
G043 503 BUSY is not an outage: data kept and marked not current, explicit retry works, no automatic retry
G043 a FOUND receipt does not refresh the connection's last accepted read nor the capture
G125 STATE_BUSY keeps the last read visible and permits only an explicit read retry
G125 missing or corrupt storage remains unavailable, not busy
